'''Marauders''' are a type of [[Mobs]], placed into the [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] Tier.

== ''Spawning'' ==
* Spawns naturally in groups of 1 to 2 if [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4, with a spawnweight of 10.
* Spawns in groups of 2 to 3 in the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 5.
* Spawned by [[Heavy Bomber|Heavy Bombers]].

==''Behavior''==
Marauders are Highly mobile Tank units and AoE melee combatants.

* Their Melee Attack inflicts AoE Damage and is performed by them pushing their limbs upward.
* Marauders second Melee Attack can grab nearby Mobs, who will then be punched to death by the Marauder. It will stay still during this Attack, moving its limbs backward and forward from its body. This Attack ignores Immunity Frames. After it ends, the [[Rage]] Effect will be inflicted onto nearby Parasites.
* Marauders can climb blocks.
* Marauders are able to perform great leaps which inflicts AoE Damage when it lands.
* Marauders can perform small leaps, both on land and in liquids.
* Marauders can sink in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* Like other [[Pure Parasites]], Marauders can summon up to 3 [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them
* Like other [[:Category:Pure Parasites|Pure Parasites]], Marauders can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport.
** Marauders (along with the other Melee focused Pures) spawn [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]] significantly less than flying and grounded range Pures.
* Marauders can break blocks that have their [[Hardness]] Value up to 5, with a 10 ticks cooldown and 3 Blocks range.
{{Variants|count=1|Breacher=BreacherMarauder.png}}

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Marauders, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Marauders' Tendrils, found on the sides of their body, can reset their [[Adaptation System|adaptation]], while also giving them the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== ''Post Death'' ===

* On death Marauders have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Pure Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

==''Trivia''== 
*Marauders are also known as '''Esor''' in the Mod Files.
*Marauders are inspired by [https://www.halopedia.org/Flood_Juggernaut Flood Juggernauts], from Halo.
*Initially, the current Marauder Model was used for the [[Warden]] in the [[Version 1.9.0A1|1.9.0A1]] Update but, after many complaints regarding this change, in [[Version 1.9.0A2|1.9.0A2]], the Warden obtained its old Model and the Marauder was introduced.
